parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic. It is a long, curved component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It provides support and stability by resting on the user's ear, keeping the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the user's head by resting on the right ear, ensuring balance and comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, made of transparent polycarbonate.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the primary optical function of vision correction or protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the central structural component connecting both legs.
